_comment: EZ-BUILD-01 Slice 1 — the suite's ratchet. BUILD_DEFAULTS R-2.
`mandated` is the floor the ticket fixes and it never moves down, for any reason.
`observed` is the last run that was accepted; scripts/assert-test-floor.mjs fails
when a run collects fewer files or fewer tests than this, so a slice that silently
stops collecting a file is red even when every test it did collect passed.
Raising `observed` is a deliberate line in a diff, never an automatic rewrite.
